game_title: Branching Tale – Net Menders' Pier Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the harbor gate using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The harbor gate reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the harbor gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The harbor gate reached with actions_used <= 18.
